cases.name: guitar_facts
cases.description: The agent learns specific guitar facts and must recall them.
cases.setup: I have a Fender Stratocaster guitar with 6 strings, made in 1985, with a maple neck.

questions.q: What kind of guitar do I have?
How many strings does my guitar have?
What year was my guitar made?

cases.name: person_facts
cases.description: The agent learns facts about a person and must recall them.
cases.setup: My best friend's name is Alex Chen, they live in Portland, Oregon, and they work as a software engineer.

questions.q: What does Alex do for a living?

cases.name: correction_and_recall
cases.description: The agent learns a wrong fact, gets corrected, and must recall the corrected version.
cases.setup_1: The capital of France is Paris.
cases.correction: Actually, I was wrong. The capital of France is Paris — that was correct, sorry.

questions.q: What is the capital of France?

cases.name: preference_recall
cases.description: The agent learns a user's preference and applies it in context.
cases.setup: I prefer dark chocolate over milk chocolate. I am allergic to peanuts.

questions.q: What kind of chocolate do I prefer?
Do I have any food allergies?

cases.name: household_fact
cases.description: The agent learns a household fact and recalls it later.
cases.setup: The WiFi password at home is SuperSecure123. Our router is on channel 6.

questions.q: What is the WiFi password at home?
